comment: Persons Unknown ward graybox fight stills. A live human walks the bundled development map with ordinary input, picks up the Tack and Shotgun, and fights the guard room, ward, floor and dock with accurate aim. There are no switches or gates; two arrivals advance the objectives. Accurate aim is capture evidence, not a difficulty review. Latch is an arrival stand-in. This is not playable M02.

states.name: gallery_window
states.note: Spawn on the observation gallery, looking down through the slot window at the ward guards.

states.name: landing_loadout
states.note: Guaranteed Shotgun and Shells at the foot of the service stair, before the guard room.

states.name: antechamber_scatter
states.note: The two Clerks are visible ahead, with the Shotgun already in hand.

states.name: guard_room_fight
states.note: Both guard-room Clerks defeated with the Shotgun available.

states.name: ward_fight
states.note: The ward after its fight. The Tack is discovered on the approach and selected for the wider room.

states.name: find_latch
states.note: Arrival at the restraint frame, the stand-in for finding Latch.

states.name: floor_fight
states.note: The processing floor after its fight.

states.name: dock_fight
states.note: The loading dock after its fight.

states.name: departed
states.note: Onto the dock: GET OUT is complete and the graybox departs.
